title: 皐月賞の後に・ご令嬢の一冠

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo grabs first place in the Satsuki Sho, the first of three races in the Classic Triple Crown tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some fans expect nothing less from "her mother's daughter," but those words of praise mean nothing to King Halo as she leaves them behind to march forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she can keep this up, she'll claim first place in the renowned Japanese Derby. With such a victory, the crowd will have no choice but to recognize her for her.
